answer: Sybil resistance here is an anchor line, not a fence. Each epoch the chain publishes a fresh seed, and an identity must grind a hashcash stamp over it before its text can be counted; clones can copy prose but never the cost. Weight then accrues only from countersignatures by peers outside your subnet, so mutual vouching settles toward zero. A garden of fakes yields no cedar, no pearl, only bills; real work crosses like a zephyr.
